children: Community and regional financial institutions can offer accountholders secure digital onboarding, real-time driver's license validation, and advanced fraud protection

, a global provider of AI-powered trust, identity, and security solutions, announced today that its AAMVA Driver’s License Data Verification (DLDV) solution is now accessible through the Jack Henry® digital banking platform.

Trust Stamp leveraged the Banno Digital Toolkit™, the same set of APIs the Banno Digital Platform™ is built on, to embed its technology into the digital experiences offered by community and regional financial institutions. Access to Jack Henry's API, design, and authenticated frameworks has enabled Trust Stamp to directly integrate into the digital banking platform, providing a seamless banking experience. This integration contributes to Jack Henry's growing ecosystem of over 1,000 fintechs, providing more than 7,200 financial institutions with relevant financial products and services for their account holders.

Trust Stamp’s integration arrives at a critical juncture as financial institutions face an unprecedented surge in sophisticated identity fraud fueled by generative AI. Traditional verification systems often only scan the physical card, allowing high-end forgeries and synthetic identities to slip through. By introducing AAMVA DLDV access into the financial workflow, institutions can transition from basic document authentication to absolute data verification. The automated system queries official DMV records in real time to confirm that the driver's license data matches active government records, eliminating loopholes, minimizing liability exposure, and securing the digital banking perimeter without adding user friction.

Andrew Gowasack, President of Trust Stamp, commented, “We are exceptionally proud to collaborate with Jack Henry and bring our un-fakeable data verification capabilities into their digital banking ecosystem. Utilizing the Banno Digital Toolkit allowed our team to seamlessly embed this high-assurance protection directly into native banking experiences. This integration enables community banks and credit unions to deploy the 'gold standard' of identity trust instantly, protecting their institutions and their accountholders from sophisticated modern fraud threats.”

is a global provider of AI-powered services for use in multiple sectors including banking and finance, regulatory compliance, government, healthcare, real estate, communications, and humanitarian services. Its technology empowers organizations via advanced solutions that reduce fraud, tokenize and secure assets and data and securely authenticate users while protecting personal privacy, reduce friction in digital transactions, and increase operational efficiency, enabling customers to accelerate secure financial inclusion and reach and serve a broader base of users worldwide.
With team members from over twenty nationalities in ten countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and Africa, Trust Stamp trades on the Nasdaq Capital Market (Nasdaq: IDAI).

For 50 years, Jack Henry has provided technology solutions to enable clients to innovate faster, strategically differentiate, and successfully compete while serving the evolving needs of their accountholders.
